sloka: सदृशाच्चापकृष्टाच्च लोके कन्यापिता जनात् ।प्रधर्षणमवाप्नोति शक्रेणापि समो भुवि ॥ २.११८.३५॥
transliteration: sadṛśāccāpakṛṣṭācca loke kanyāpitā janāt ।pradharṣaṇamavāpnoti śakreṇāpi samo bhuvi ॥ 2.118.35॥

translations.english: Even though he was an Indra on earth, as a father of an unmarried girl he would be humiliated by men who are his equal or inferior in this world.
